display.purpose: Every h1/h2/h3, hero card title. Never body copy or labels.

body.purpose: Card prose, form content, empty-state and list copy.

label.purpose: Dates, statuses, captions, form labels, counts — anything read as a system-generated fact.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for every card, panel, filed item.

shadows.name: card-lifted
shadows.purpose: Hero card at rest; any card's hover/focus state.

shadows.name: spine
shadows.purpose: Fixed desktop spine and mobile bottom nav bar.

motion.name: flip
motion.purpose: The card-flip signature interaction; snaps instead under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: view-transition-settle
motion.purpose: The live-update focal moment (useLiveSync's View Transitions crossfade on SSE events).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most-committal action per surface (Sign in, Add chore, Done).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #a1401a; color: #faf6ea; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-family: 'Public Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a1401a; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: #faf6ea; color: #2a241c; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-family: 'Public Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid #ab8352; border-radius: 0.5rem; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a1401a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: The shared cardstock input, used across every form.
components.css: .ds-field { background: #faf6ea; border: 1px solid #d9c8a3; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.4rem 0.65rem; color: #2a241c; font-family: 'Public Sans Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; } .ds-field:focus { border-color: #a1401a; outline: 2px solid #a1401a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Flip Card (front)
components.description: The signature per-item card — ruled cardstock front with a status label, corner stamp-dot, and a flip hint.
components.css: .ds-flipcard-front { position: relative; text-align: left; width: 100%; background-color: #faf6ea; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, transparent 27px, #e6dabb 27px, #e6dabb 28px); border: 1px solid #d9c8a3; border-radius: 0.85rem; padding: 1.25rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(74,54,32,0.12), 0 8px 20px -6px rgba(74,54,32,0.28); transition: box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-flipcard-front:hover, .ds-flipcard-front:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(74,54,32,0.14), 0 20px 34px -10px rgba(74,54,32,0.38); } .ds-dot { position: absolute; top: 1rem; right: 1rem; width: 0.625rem; height: 0.625rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: #a1401a; } .ds-status { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #a1401a; } .ds-title { margin-top: 0.5rem; font-size: 1.125rem; color: #2a241c; } .ds-hint { display: block; margin-top: 0.75rem; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #686056; }

components.name: Done Stack (collapsed)
components.description: The 'stamp, don't delete' filed-items toggle — two overlapping riffled card corners plus a mono count line.
components.css: .ds-donestack { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: none; border: none; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #686056; } .ds-donestack-icon { position: relative; display: inline-flex; width: 2.25rem; height: 1.75rem; } .ds-donestack-back, .ds-donestack-front { position: absolute; width: 1.5rem; height: 1.25rem; border: 1px solid rgba(171,131,82,0.6); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-donestack-back { background: #f2ead6; transform: translate(-0.25rem, -0.125rem) rotate(-12deg); } .ds-donestack-front { background: #faf6ea; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(74,54,32,0.12), 0 8px 20px -6px rgba(74,54,32,0.28); transform: translate(0.25rem, 0.125rem) rotate(6deg); }

components.name: Nav Spine Tab (desktop)
components.description: One module tab on the fixed left spine — vertical text at rest, horizontal + card-colored panel when active.
components.css: .ds-spinetab { display: flex; height: 5rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 0.25rem; font-family: 'Architects Daughter', cursive; font-size: 0.875rem; color: rgba(250,246,234,0.9); writing-mode: vertical-rl; } .ds-spinetab-active { writing-mode: horizontal-tb; background: #faf6ea; color: #2a241c; }

narrative.overview: doma reads as the household's own recipe/index-card file box left open on the counter, not a productivity dashboard. Cream cardstock cards sit under kraft-brown tab dividers; a rust/terracotta ink marks whatever is active or due, and a quiet graphite-blue marks settled, already-typed metadata. Every card face is ruled like real index-card stock. The box is genuinely a box — a 'screen' is a stack of cards you flip through, and navigation is a tab spine down the left edge (a bottom bar on mobile), not a sidebar-and-card-grid SaaS layout. This build shipped the world essentially as specified in docs/design-direction.md — no material divergence between the locked direction and the built surfaces. The one thing the build adds beyond the brief's letter is an ambient time-of-day background wash that tints the page behind the cards on a 4-part day cycle, confirmed in the brief's raises list as atmosphere-only, never load-bearing for meaning or state. doma is explicitly not corporate/SaaS, not clinical, and not twee/scrapbook — it avoids both the sidebar-dashboard genre and the cream-paper-plus-serif-plus-lamplight default a 'warm domestic app' brief reaches for by habit.
keyCharacteristics: Cardstock-cream palette with kraft-brown structure and one warm accent (rust) plus one cool accent (blue) — no third hue
A handwritten display face (Architects Daughter) reserved for headings only; body and metadata stay in a clean grotesk/mono pairing
Status reads through ink color and a small corner dot, never a heavy accent border
Depth comes from warm, brown-tinted drop shadows (never neutral-gray), never from a bevel or gradient fill
Completed work is filed, not deleted — the 'done' stack pattern

rules.name: The Ink-Not-Border Rule
rules.body: Status (overdue, active) is carried by text color and a small corner stamp-dot, never a thick accent border competing with the card's rounded silhouette.

rules.name: The One Warm, One Cool Rule
rules.body: Rust marks what needs attention; blue marks what's already settled. No third status color exists in the shipped system.

rules.name: The Metadata-Is-Mono Rule
rules.body: Any text that reads as a system-generated fact rather than authored content — dates, statuses, counts, captions — renders in font-mono at a small tracked-out size.

rules.name: The Lift-On-Front Rule
rules.body: Elevation increases only when a card becomes (or is about to become) the frontmost thing. Elevation is never used as ambient screen-wide decoration.

dos: Do keep the display face (Architects Daughter) to headings only; route every metadata, date, status, and caption string through font-mono.
Do carry status through ink color and a small corner dot, matching the shipped rust-overdue / blue-settled pair — don't add a third status color without collapsing it into this system.
Do use warm, kraft/ink-tinted shadow color (rgba(74,54,32,…)) for any new elevation, never neutral gray.
Do render a not-yet-built module as a blank, same-weight reserved tab (spine band or bar slot with only a screen-reader label) — never gray it out, disable-style it, or hide it.
Do keep the ruled-baseline background-image as the system's only texture; it belongs on card faces (front and back), not as a general decorative device.
Do use the two-step radius scale only (rounded-tab 0.5rem for controls, rounded-card 0.85rem for cards/panels) — no third radius.
donts: Don't put the primary flow inside a sidebar-and-card-grid dashboard layout. The tab spine plus card-fan/deck is the system's only navigation-plus-content topology; a settings-style two-pane admin layout is out of world.

Don't fade a card flip or a live-update settle. Both have named, deliberate motion (a real 3D rotate; a View Transitions crossfade), never a plain opacity fade, and both must respect prefers-reduced-motion by snapping instead of animating.
Don't hard-delete a completed item from view. It files into a DoneStack; the interaction vocabulary has no 'vanish' state for finished work.
Don't use the ambient time-of-day wash for anything but atmosphere — it must never be the only signal for a state or a piece of information (per the direction brief's own raise).
